chunks: 1803 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever fasts one day in the way of Allah, it is equivalent to a year that he fasts."

key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ: in the way of Allah; for His sake and cause
key_terms.يَعْدِلُ: is equal to; corresponds in reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting one day in the way of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the immense reward of fasting for the sake of Allah. It teaches that a single day of sawm performed in His way can carry the reward of an entire year of fasting, encouraging devotion and sincerity in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1803 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever fasts a day in the way of Allah (swt), it is equivalent to fasting a whole year."
